credibility.headline: Met 3 of 6 checkable promises
credibility.line: Missed QRSAM order and order inflow including QRSAM; short on capex; delivered revenue growth, EBITDA margin and order inflow.

rows.label: QRSAM order
rows.reason: The QRSAM order was not secured in Q4 FY26 due to procedural delays.

promised.speaker: Manoj Jain
promised.quote: We are confident to get this order by February, March as of now also. It may not slip to Q1 of next year. We are confident we may get in the Q4 of this year itself QRSAM

delivered.label: QRSAM order
delivered.quote: And QRSAM, we told we were highly optimistic to get it by March, but procedural delays we knew, that is why we told it may go to Q1/Q2, maximum by September we will get and I am still sticking to that.
